claims.text: The model achieves the best performance improvements on Comparison and Temporal relations, with F1-score improvements of 6 and 7 points respectively.
The model performs best in recognizing implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The CRF layer is noted to be unsuitable for binary classification, indicating limitations in certain discourse relations.
